name: ai.tsoden.serp/ai-visibility-audit
title: Tsoden AI Visibility Audit
description: Live checks: AI crawler access, llms.txt, entity schema and AI-search readiness of any site.

tools.name: audit_ai_readiness
tools.description: Run a live audit of a website's readiness to be found and quoted by answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) and classic search. Fetches the home page and a few internal pages, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt, then returns an AI-readiness score (0-100), an SEO hygiene score and pass/warn/fail checks with their meaning. Use it when the user asks whether their site is visible in AI answers or what to fix first.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. https://example.com or example.com.

tools.name: check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Check which AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others) a site's robots.txt allows or blocks, and whether its /llms.txt exists and is valid. Returns a shareable result page on https://serp.tsoden.ai.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. https://example.com or example.com.

tools.name: check_schema_readiness
tools.description: Read a page's JSON-LD structured data and report which entity signals an answer engine needs to describe the brand confidently (name, URL, logo, description, sameAs profiles, contact) are present or missing. Returns a shareable result page.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. https://example.com or example.com.

tools.name: find_prompt_opportunities
tools.description: Read a site and suggest the questions people ask answer engines where this brand could plausibly be recommended — the prompts worth tracking and writing content for. Returns a shareable result page.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. https://example.com or example.com.

tools.name: get_ai_readiness_benchmark
tools.description: Return the public aggregate benchmark from sites checked with these tools: how often AI crawlers are blocked, how common llms.txt is, and how complete entity structured data usually is. Use it to put one site's result in context.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Explain what Tsoden SERP Checker can check without an account, what a connected account adds (tracked rankings and answer-engine visibility for the user's own projects) and how to connect it. Use it when the user asks how to connect an account or how to track results over time.
